text: くやしくて　なみだも　でん

patterns.name: 〜くて
patterns.explanation: A describing word ending in くて gives the reason for what follows: 'so ... that'. くやしくて = 'I'm so frustrated that'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is the old-man and dialect way of saying ない, 'not'. でん is the same as でない = 'won't come out'.
